$comment: Priority weights for the generated /oneclient/mods.json feed.
Higher numbers are shown first by the website; anything not listed here defaults to 0.
Negative numbers push a mod down the list without hiding it.
A key matches a mod by Modrinth slug, Modrinth project id, or .pw.toml filename.
Keys that match nothing produce a build warning, so remove a mod's key when it leaves the pack.
